scope: Independently register bounded original declared source generations for four PAPER entry components, transport them through original enrollment/cash/evaluation/manifest and per-entry provenance, and close the same-size/same-mtime case-cache gap. Preserve valid independent peers, already funded virtual exits, exact0.1 SOL PAPER and uncapped residual upside. No operational runtime, provider, wallet, order, training or artifact/policy activation.

findings.evidence: Original plans bind threshold configuration and exits, but not independently the gate leaf and common temporal/adaptation code. Native synthetic cases reproduce missing original registration and accepted cohort/cache/fill despite a virtual source-file generation change.
findings.repair: Capture a fixed known-source inventory before the original gate decisions. Require consistent original identities across plan, case, hash-chained journal, owned cash prefix, complete cohort, manifest and selection. Recheck current declared source content before and after registration, pending quote awaits, cohort replay and new binding. Source drift blocks new entry/adaptation, not an independently owned funded exit.

findings.evidence: A warmed five-second selection cache returns its original accepted policy after an original case changes content while retaining exact byte size and mtime.
findings.repair: Read and canonical-hash every original case on every selection call. Reuse only the expensive cohort calculation, replay detached captured cases, and recheck original sources/content after calculation or before a cache return. Original-case alterations cannot borrow the old accepted cache result.

source_contract.normalization: Normalized LF source SHA256 and canonical detached original receipt digest. Current source bytes are read afresh; timestamps cannot certify source identity. Exact known relative inventory/order is required; escaped, extra, duplicate, malformed or missing identities fail closed.
source_contract.case_content: Canonical parsed original-case SHA256, not literal whitespace equality and not metadata-only equality. Missing, oversized by the existing reader guard, malformed, nonfinite or changed declared original evidence stays unapproved.
source_contract.legacy: No original operator plan/case/manifest is rewritten or backfilled. Legacy v1 entry diagnostic bindings remain readable without fabricated source proof. New production bindings use source-bearing thresholds_v2/composition_v2; source-free binding primitives are simulations, not approvals. Proved and simulation-only components cannot be mixed.
source_contract.historical_receipts: Validate v2 historical source receipt structure without requiring today's code, so old original decisions remain inspectable. A new binding and new policy approval separately require current source matching.
source_contract.exit_separation: Entry-source drift alone cannot orphan an already funded owned virtual case. Existing frozen financial exit, quote/FX, quantity and conservation controls remain independent. Cash-valuation awaits additionally keep original source metadata immutable.
source_contract.limitation: This declares source-file generations; it does not attest actual loaded/executed Python, authenticate a hostile whole-root rewrite, validate every transitive/third-party dependency or prove original provider input/confirmation availability. Those boundaries remain independent.
